dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: #It's been a while, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The atmosphere is pleasant and to my liking.

choices.text: As long as it satisfies you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: In the time that I've known you, I've come to glean some information about your character and principles.

choices.text: I was worried that you would find this place childish.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Everything comes from nothing, and that which is small becomes large, one step at a time.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: While I've lived many years, I'm not inflexible enough to be incapable of appreciating youthful trends.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Your taste always sets others at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: That would be my pleasure. What would you like to discuss?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to hear you talk about the past.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The past... Then let us find a free day to take our time and talk.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A millennium's worth of stories cannot be told in one moment.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If you wish to be comfortable while listening, we'll need a pot of fine tea, two quality chairs, and a pleasing courtyard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need to prepare a courtyard?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Haha, don't trouble yourself. This place will do just fine. We can sit down and take our time chatting.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As of late, I've been thinking about housing arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: This residence of yours has unique scenery and elegant furnishings which I find very attractive.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I frequently come and go. Excuse my disturbances.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Speaking of such things, I ought to contribute something to your realm.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: And so...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: If it does not bother you, I would like to find a gift for you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A pity... As they say, "only a mighty sword is worthy of a mighty hero." A gift befitting you truly is difficult to come by.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Fortunately, we have plenty of time, so there's no need to rush a decision.

choices.text: No need to be so polite.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: While I may no longer be the Geo Archon, I can be considered an old-fashioned citizen of Liyue.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I have my courtesy. When the time comes, please accept it without worries.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hm... As long as you agree to accept it.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I have witnessed much from you. Our time is boundless... A carefree life relies upon a resolute and clear heart.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Being with you like this is truly a lively and joyous experience.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Good morning. Though your journey be fair, do not unduly tire yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The night grows darker, so rest when you can. May you have pleasant dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The people of Liyue follow a multitude of rules when arranging the furniture in a study. These decorative arts can largely be organized into three schools of thought and nine areas of specialization.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You have never heard my explanations on the subject, and yet you still avoided every taboo.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Perhaps some tacit connection has formed between us during our journey together.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The flourishing city of Liyue developed from small streets dotted with a few shops, just like this one.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: You have a talent for many pursuits, as well as a boldness of spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: To me, each day spent with you is as valuable as gold.
